scope: CORS configured-origin policy and preflight behavior
before: CORS used fixed local origins and ignored FRONTEND_URL, blocking a correctly configured production frontend.
protections: FRONTEND_URL is included in the effective allowlist
additional origins require explicit comma-separated configuration
wildcard, credentials, paths, query, fragment, and non-HTTP schemes are rejected
local Vite origins are limited to local/testing environments
allowed and foreign preflights are covered
